errors.text: The proposed perturbation scheme is not explicitly DFT–MTP free-energy perturbation; reduced thermodynamic integration, harmonic references, and heating/cooling cycles do not reconstruct the target intervention.
The liquid training strategy emphasizes surfaces, unstable stacking faults, and Fe–Al magnetic configurations, none of which establishes accurate sampling of TaVCrW liquid phase space.

The claimed greater-than-100-fold speedup and less-than-5% melting-temperature error are unsupported and disagree with the target metrics of approximately 80% savings or 20-fold speedup and sub-0.5 meV/atom free-energy agreement.

The hypothesis elevates magnetic effects as potentially central, whereas the target found high-temperature magnetic fluctuations negligible and identified electronic excitations and solid-state short-range order as the important corrections.
